summary: Scaleway offers €100 free credit when you create a Business account, promoted on the Generative APIs signup page as a way to get started with their Europe-hosted OpenAI-compatible APIs. This is separate from the Generative APIs free tier of 1,000,000 tokens + 60 minutes of transcription.
claim_steps: Create a Business account to receive €100 free credit.
Use the credit with Generative APIs and other Scaleway services as billed.

social_proof.title: Generative APIs | Scaleway
social_proof.text: Get started with €100 free credit when you create a Business account. Unlock €100 free credit with a Business account.
